metadata.authoring: Original Greenbox chibi occupied-cube artwork; no external character asset or likeness
metadata.design: Original tropical grower: oversized cubic head, compact body, short sturdy legs, knitted red/gold/green cap and readable locs. Restrained 2x2 dark eyes and clean graphic features. Visual inspiration from The Touryst: https://thetouryst.shinen.com/deluxe/; no copied game assets, characters or textures.
